users.title: Users
users.subtitle: Staff accounts and what each person can do.
users.identifierHint: Email, mobile number, or both — either can be used to sign in.
users.temporaryPasswordNote: Shown once. Give it to the person directly — they must change it when they first sign in.
users.deactivateConfirm: Deactivate {name}? They are signed out everywhere immediately.
users.resetConfirm: Issue a new temporary password for {name}? They are signed out everywhere.
users.permissionsSubtitle: Grant a module, then the actions within it. Anything not granted is hidden from the person entirely.
users.presetNote: Replaces every configurable permission with the preset.
